newsitem.title: USA: Ringer drops Chas. Lilly acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Ringer drops Chas. Lilly acquisition.

text.p: Ringer Corp said Thursday it will not proceed with the previously announced acquisition of Chas. H. Lilly Co, an Oregon-based marketer of fertilizers, pesticides and seeds.

"While both companies put significant effort into completing this transaction, it was felt that at this time, given the original terms and conditions, the acquisition no longer made economic sense," Stanley Goldberg, Ringer president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Goldberg said merger and acquisition activities will continue to play a major role in the development of Ringer.

"(I)n addition to operating our current business effectively, we will continue to aggressively pursue other acquisition opportunities which provide growth while enhancing shareholder value," Goldberg said.
On October 2, Ringer said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire all the outstanding stock of Chas. Lilly, whose annual sales were estimated between $27 million and $30 million.
Ringer develops and markets lawn and garden care products.
